name: Jakarta Running Festival Half Marathon
short_description: The myBCA Jakarta Half Marathon, the 21.1 km race of Jakarta Running Festival 2026, ran on Saturday 24 October 2026 from Gelora Bung Karno, Jakarta, flagging off at 4.30am.
ai_summary: The myBCA Jakarta Half Marathon is the half marathon of Jakarta Running Festival 2026, run on Saturday 24 October 2026 over 21.097 km at the Gelora Bung Karno Sports Complex in Jakarta, Indonesia. It flagged off at 4.30am with a cut-off of 3 hours 45 minutes after the start. The festival's full marathon ran separately the next day, Sunday 25 October.

core_facts.venue: Gelora Bung Karno (GBK) Sports Complex, Senayan

pros: Flags off at 4.30am, ahead of the worst of the heat
Has its own race day, separate from the festival marathon
Starts and finishes at the Gelora Bung Karno Sports Complex in central Jakarta

faqs.question: When was the myBCA Jakarta Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The myBCA Jakarta Half Marathon ran on Saturday 24 October 2026, the first race day of Jakarta Running Festival 2026. It flagged off at 4.30am from the Gelora Bung Karno Sports Complex in Senayan, central Jakarta, according to the official race page, so most runners finished before the morning heat built up.

faqs.question: What was the cut-off for the Jakarta half marathon?
faqs.answer: The overall cut-off was 3 hours 45 minutes after the 4.30am start, so 8.15am, according to the official race page. The page also lists two intermediate cut-off points on the course: 6.30am at the 10.5 km mark and 7.15am at the 15.5 km mark. All three times are counted from the start gun, not from when each runner crossed the start line.

faqs.question: Is the half marathon on the same day as the Jakarta Running Festival marathon?
faqs.answer: No. Jakarta Running Festival 2026 spread its races over two days. The half marathon ran on Saturday 24 October, and the festival's full marathon ran separately on Sunday 25 October 2026, both from the Gelora Bung Karno Sports Complex. Each race day has its own results from the timer, ScoreNow.

faqs.question: Where are the 2026 results?
faqs.answer: The timer, ScoreNow, published the half marathon results as Day 1 of the festival; the link is at the top of this page. The organiser labels them unofficial until confirmed.
